title: Altadena Community Meeting - November 17, 2025
description:
Altadena Community Meeting - November 17, 2025 - Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors Chair Kathryn Barger will host an Altadena Community Meeting for residents impacted by the Eaton Fire.

Reminder: please submit questions in real-time using the Zoom meeting link: http://bit.ly/40yMyHJ. Questions submitted in this YouTube Live Chat will not be answered. Use Zoom instead.

Watch the meeting live on the County's YouTube page. Missed the last meeting? All previous Altadena Community Meetings are available to watch on the County's YouTube page.

For more information, FAQs, and resources, visit recovery.lacounty.gov/Altadena
